ensemble.narrative: Sampled 2,000 forward paths for BA over 5 trading days as a weighted mixture of 12 generator rules, seeded by 25 historical analogs that all closed on or before 2019-03-08 -- closest: BA 2008-10-10 (-22.3%), BA 2008-11-11 (-18.0%), BA 2009-03-03 (-17.2%). The coarse-grained result: median -1.1%, 90% interval [-13.8%, +10.4%]; the scenario prior (heuristic-fallback) contributed an expected -3.1% 5-day drift on the 45% of paths that accept drift, and a 1.35x width multiplier on all of them. Changing the generator rule moves the median by 7.1 percentage points, which is our honest uncertainty about the rule itself rather than about the noise draw.

leakage_disclosure: Any LLM in this pipeline has read the post-2019 world. Cutting input data at 2019-12-31 does not cut the weights. We therefore report lift over a null model rather than raw accuracy, test obscure events alongside famous ones and report them separately, and say so here, in the product. See CONTRACT.md s8.
